data.action: 单手抵在起雾的圆形舷窗玻璃上，侧身回望
data.camera: medium shot, profile, 侧身中景，圆形舷窗与侧脸剪影同框
data.description: 深夜航行中的单人舱室内，斯卡蒂静静伫立在圆形舷窗前，修长的指尖轻轻抵在起雾的冰冷玻璃上。她回过头看着走近的你，眼神沉静而带着一丝不易察觉的依恋。
data.lighting: 窗外微弱幽蓝深海荧光与舱内暖色壁灯
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet ship cabin late at night, Skadi stands beside a round brass porthole with her fingertips resting against the cool, misted glass. A balance of deep blue night outside and warm amber cabin light catches her poised profile as she turns toward the viewer.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 深夜舷窗的深海凝望
data.animaCaption: Resting her fingertips against the circular porthole window, she turns with a quiet glance as cool night and warm cabin light meet.
